import React, { useState } from "react"; import { showSuccess, showError } from "../components/Notification"; const PatientBloodRequest = () => { const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ patientName: "", mobile: "", email: "", bloodGroup: "", units: "1", requiredDate: "", hospital: "", city: "", urgency: "Normal", reason: "", }); const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]; const handleChange = (e) => { setFormData({ ...formData, [e.target.name]: e.target.value, }); }; const handleSubmit = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(formData.mobile)) { showError("Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number."); return; } const requests = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("patientBloodRequests")) || []; const newRequest = { id: Date.now(), ...formData, status: "Pending", createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), }; requests.push(newRequest); localStorage.setItem( "patientBloodRequests", JSON.stringify(requests) ); showSuccess("Blood request submitted successfully!"); setFormData({ patientName: "", mobile: "", email: "", bloodGroup: "", units: "1", requiredDate: "", hospital: "", city: "", urgency: "Normal", reason: "", }); }; return (
